subject: physical-education
unitTitle: Leadership Capstone: Facilitating an Inclusive Activity
essentialQuestion: Can I run something that other people leave better than they arrived?

prompts.prompt: Explain the critical features or key principle of designing a session for a real group with real constraints in your own words.
Demonstrate or fully describe safety planning and organizer responsibility using a version your body and setting allow. A described or adapted version earns full credit.
Apply inclusive format, language, and scoring decisions in a new situation and explain the decision or adjustment you made.
Analyze a plausible technique fault, tactical error, or unsafe choice involving adapting live when the plan meets reality; correct it and explain why.
Connect gathering feedback that is actually useful with evaluating the session against inclusion, not turnout and explain how one affects the other.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Design, deliver, and evaluate one inclusive activity session for a real group, or deliver it for one participant with a complete plan if a group is not available, and revise the design from feedback.
Identify one thing you can now do or direct yourself, one adjustment that improved it, and one next goal you set for yourself.

adaptationChoices: Group size is never a requirement; a session delivered to one person with a complete plan meets the standard fully.
accommodationNote: Access supports may change format, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. An adapted or described performance is full credit, not partial credit.
neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.
This task never requires calorie counting or a diet or weight-loss goal.
This task never requires disclosing private medical history, a diagnosis, or sexual history.
This task never requires a photograph, video, or voice recording of the learner as proof.
This task never requires a public performance or an audience.
